releases.body:
The settings card drew its outline with `--dsw-alias-border-l2` at 1px — the design system's internal-divider token (10% alpha) — so beside the official cards it read as having no border. It now uses the surface token every dsh card and input uses: `.5px solid var(--dsw-alias-border-l4)` with the official 16px radius, and the card's inputs take the same outline. Internal separators and the discard button keep `l2`, where dsh uses it too.

Published to npm with provenance: `dsh plugin add dsh-querit@1.1.1`.
